name: CityKlub
tagline: Spontaneous plans with real people, in your city
summary: A map-first mobile app for spontaneous, free activities in Cologne. Discover what's happening today and tomorrow, form small groups around curated city events, and chat once you're approved to join.

features.title: Today & Tomorrow
features.description: Discovery focused on what's happening right now and next — no endless scrolling through old events.

features.title: Small Group Plans
features.description: Create a plan or request to join one, and form small groups around curated city events.

features.title: Approve, Then Chat
features.description: Approximate locations are public; exact meeting points stay protected until your request is approved.

name: Aura Baby
summary: A one-stop parenting app infused with AI, designed to guide, support, and simplify every stage of early parenthood.

features.title: AI Deep Research
features.description: Trusted resources on baby, parenting, and more.

features.title: Discuss & Discover
features.description: Discuss and find insights about your baby.

name: Tiny Foundation
summary: A tiny knowledge workspace for managing small, composable units of knowledge. Ground AI in strict, version-controlled context to prevent hallucinations, with native Model Context Protocol (MCP) integration.

features.title: Precise Results
features.description: Extract highly accurate semantic graphs from your text, grounding AI in absolute, version-controlled context.

features.title: Native MCP
features.description: Expose your governed knowledge directly to AI agents securely through built-in Model Context Protocol integration.

features.title: Small Knowledge
features.description: Break down complex information into tiny, composable units of markdown.

features.title: Governance
features.description: Every document change is tracked and versioned, so you can review before publishing.

name: AlloLand
tagline: Your expat journey, guided by those who've been there
summary: AlloLand connects expats in Europe with mentors who've lived your exact situation — covering housing, visas, careers, banking, and local life — so you get real answers, not generic advice.

features.title: Find a Mentor
features.description: Browse mentors by country, topic, and experience level for insight from expats who've navigated the same challenges.

features.title: Real Conversations
features.description: Book 1-on-1 sessions on your schedule and get answers to the specific questions that Google can't answer.

features.title: Become a Mentor
features.description: Turn your hard-won expat experience into something valuable and help newcomers navigate what you once figured out alone.
